subject.title: feat: apply messages.responsePrefix to message tool outbound sends

question: Should `message(action=send)` inherit the active turn's selected provider/model/full-model/thinking context for `messages.responsePrefix` templates, or should message-tool sends remain static/identity-only?
rationale: Current code intentionally skips unresolved selected-model placeholders because the outbound send path does not own model selection, while docs and operator comments expect those variables to represent the actual current attempt.

options.title: Support current-turn template parity
options.body: Carry selected provider/model/thinking context into source-visible message-tool sends that belong to the active turn, with explicit behavior for cross-chat, broadcast, dry-run, and no-active-run cases.

options.title: Document static/identity-only tool sends
options.body: Keep current behavior and update docs so `{model}`, `{modelFull}`, `{provider}`, and `{thinkingLevel}` are advertised only for normal reply paths.

options.title: Fold into broader attribution work
options.body: Leave this issue open only as context for a larger model-attribution design such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/33975.

recommendation.title: Support current-turn template parity
recommendation.body: Carry selected provider/model/thinking context into source-visible message-tool sends that belong to the active turn, with explicit behavior for cross-chat, broadcast, dry-run, and no-active-run cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent adjacent message-action work make this the best available owner for the product/runtime boundary decision.
